landing.heroSubtitle: A simple, voice-assisted dashboard helping farmers maximize harvest yield, scan leaf diseases, analyze real-time market prices, and find government subsidies.
landing.testimonialQuote: "Using the Crop Advisor and Disease Scanner, I was able to diagnose Early Blight on my tomatoes and save my harvest. The voice support is wonderful."
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need In One App
landing.featuresSubtitle: All tools are integrated seamlessly and optimized for elder accessibility.
landing.featWeatherDesc: Real-time weather insights, rain percentage, and actionable farm advisories to schedule irrigation, harvesting, and pest control.
landing.featCropDesc: Advanced agricultural suggestion engine matching your local state, district, soil type, and budget with high-yield crops.
landing.featDiseaseDesc: Scan crops with your smartphone camera to diagnose diseases instantly, complete with organic remedies and prevention advice.
landing.featMandiDesc: Track live crop prices in your nearby markets and compare mandi rates to sell your agricultural yield at peak profit.
landing.accVoiceDesc: Farmers can navigate the entire system and listen to weather forecasts or government schemes read aloud in English, Hindi, Tamil, and Marathi.
landing.accEaseDesc: Custom UI optimized for elder accessibility with options for large font sizes, high-contrast themes, and intuitive grid layouts.
landing.accSchemesDesc: Bookmark and apply for PM-Kisan, Fasal Bima Yojana, and loan subsidies directly with simplified process manuals.
landing.faq1Q: How does the crop disease scanner work?
landing.faq1A: Simply upload or snap a photo of the infected crop leaves on the disease scanner page. Our simulator analyzes the leaf pattern and returns the identified disease, symptoms, and organic/chemical remedies.
landing.faq2Q: Can I use this app without internet access?
landing.faq2A: Yes, the system caches government schemes and mandi prices. You can view your bookmarked schemes and cached market listings even when offline.
landing.faq3Q: Is this application available in regional languages?
landing.faq3A: Absolutely. We support English, Hindi, Tamil, and Marathi. You can toggle your preferred language from the top navbar at any time.
landing.contactTitle: Have Queries? Speak with our Helpdesk
landing.contactSubtitle: We provide 24/7 agricultural advisory support via telephone lines or standard portal messages.
landing.callbackSuccess: Help request submitted successfully. A specialist will call you shortly!
